CoralWatch

Enter your Coralwatch Data

Remember to submit your survey (bottom of page) when completed.
Select your group name from the drop-down menu if you have entered data previously. If you cannot find your group name, please email the group name to info@coralwatch.org.

items.source: Please indicate the water depth when the corals were surveyed, either in metres or feet, or indicate if a depth measurement was not available.
Please enter the water temperature in either degrees celcius or farenheit, or indicate if a measurement was not available.
Please ensure that GPS coordinates are removed from all uploaded photos as this may affect your site selection.

SEARCH and SELECT EXISTING REEFS from the location drop-down list.

If your reef is not on the list, please email CoralWatch at info@coralwatch.org and provide the GPS Coordinates and reef name.

For GPS, please use WGS84 decimal degrees format. For reef name, include the area and country name.

The new reef location will be added to the database ASAP.
Please use WGS84 decimal degrees format.
